facts.fact: Voice of America reports President Hichilema signed Zambia's Access to Information bill into law in December 2023, and the government spokesperson says it is now law.

ZMB.note: The law names the Human Rights Commission as oversight institution, but no rule made or body taking up the job is reported.
The document says nothing about a data protection law.
The document states nothing on a data protection law, ratification, authority or practice.
The document states nothing on standards bodies or international standards.
An opposition leader names the Malabo Convention only as a benchmark; no signature, ratification or national law is stated.
